name: layout-grid
summary: The product's 12-column layout grid — MRow / MCol (wrappers over Ant a-row/a-col), ~540/~522 files. MCol :size is a span out of 12: 6 = half (the default form field), 12 = full, 3 = quarter, 4 = third, 2 = sixth. :gutter="16" for form rows; :gutter="0" only for structural wrappers; auto-size shrinks a column to its content.
decisionFlow: Use the 12-col MRow/MCol grid for FORM and content column layout inside a screen region (6 = half, 12 = full, gutter 16).
Laying out the whole SCREEN (header / body / side panel)? -> that's layout-screen-regions, not the form grid.
A dashboard of resizable widget tiles? -> that's the widget GridLayout (a known gap — STOP-and-ASK), NOT this form grid.
One field per row full-width, or two half-width fields side by side -> 12 / 6+6. Action buttons -> auto-size col.

size.note: column span (out of 12); the row fills with 12/size equal columns

auto-size.note: show the 'filling field + content-width action buttons' row

do: Use MRow/MCol for all form field layouts.
gutter 16 for form rows; gutter 0 only for structural wrappers.
auto-size for action/compact cells; align inside a cell with flex utilities.
dont: Don't hand-roll a flex grid for form layouts.
Don't put a gutter on full-height structural wrappers (use gutter 0).
Don't nest deep grids where a single MRow of sized MCols works.

a11y.summary: Layout primitive — no semantics of its own; MRow/MCol are presentational wrappers. The fields/controls placed inside carry the semantics and tab order.

knownIssues: Diagram reproduces the visual grid with CSS; the product uses MRow/MCol (wrappers over Ant a-row/a-col).

[element] The obs-layout-* WEB COMPONENT is a fixed visual demo, not a slotted layout primitive — you can't put a real page inside it. Use the layout GUIDANCE (decisionFlow/regions) + compose the shell from atoms + the 12-col grid + tokens.
changelog: 2026-06-29: added — the 12-column splits + interactive size/gutter/auto-size; render-first from the story.
2026-06-29: examples width fixed (cells were collapsing to content width).
2026-07-01: primary button weight 600→500 to match the product Button; native-control font reset.
whenToUse: The default way to lay out form fields and any content needing predictable column proportions — 6 = half a row, 12 = full, with a 16px gutter.
usedIn: Every form field layout (MRow ~540 files · MCol ~522 files).
Cards, summary rows, split panels — anywhere needing column proportions.
Default form layout is 6 / 6 (two-up); size 12 for textareas / full-width fields.
